items.title: John Budd interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997 [transcript only]
items.q: Yes. Glen Gray. His right name is Glen Gray Knoblauch.

ctx.x: Yes. Glen Gray. His right name is Glen Gray Knoblauch. K-N-O-B-L-A-U-C-H. Glen Gray Knoblauch.
Well he knew that that part probably wasn’t best for his professional career.
